name: MH Robot & Automation Co., Ltd.
summary: MH Robot & Automation Co., Ltd., established in Weifang, China, in 2010, is a leading provider of sophisticated industrial and automation solutions. The company delivers a comprehensive range of services, including advanced intelligent equipment systems, Internet of Things (IoT) platforms, strategic planning and design, and complete Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) services. Their extensive product portfolio features: Intelligent welding systems: These integrate robotic arms, precise positioning fixtures, welding apparatus, water and electricity supply mechanisms, and advanced control units. Smart coating systems: Primarily designed for the automotive industry, encompassing pretreatment, electrophoresis, spraying, and drying processes. Automated conveying solutions: A diverse array of systems such as skid, plate chain, ground drag, friction, roller, single-track and double-track bicycle trolleys, skateboards, reverse monorail, and painting double chain conveyors. Intelligent environmental protection systems: Offering smart solutions for VOCs (Volatile Organic Compounds) waste gas treatment and wastewater management. Utility power and equipment energy supply systems: Ensuring robust energy infrastructure for industrial operations.
